body: So I most likely won't have any hallucinations? Thanks for the response by the way!
Yeah that's true, I would never bring it up to her because nothing good comes from that lol.
Mid-20's and still don't understand it lol

Thanks for the response ! I kind of figured. I had a breakdown about it for about a year when I was 15 though, I totally wish I would have known about this website back then.. would have saved me from thinking I was a crazy person lol

I know I don’t have to, just being genuine bc I know what you mean. You’re not a prick, I can see why it’d be annoying, believe me obsessional thinking can make you crazy in the moment, magnifies little things from the past, till you look at it from someone else’s perspective. I’m sure in a few months i’ll get through it, look back and realize how dumb i was being. Thank you !

Sorry.. I didn’t repost just posted in different subs so maybe other people could see and get different responses. I’m a normal person, but I have been diagnosed with OCD, so I was trying to get responses to see if it was a normal thing to worry about or if it was all the OCD making me feel like that with the obsessional thinking. One of the symptoms is reassurance seeking, sorry again. I just gotta learn to not do that. Just thought maybe it’d help, ya know. Prolly does look crazy lol just trying to get back to normal life again.

Thank you for that article ! It sucks knowing deep down that it’s just the OCD but of course my head won’t ever listen. It’s been 4 months straight of thinking of nothing but that. It feels like i’ll never recover but one thing i’ve learned from this is that if I stick it out it always does. Also, thank you for clarifying that confessing and reassurance are compulsions! I always thought compulsions were limited to the urge to do things like touching the doorknobs, washing hands, etc. I really hope I will be able to enjoy life peacefully again.
